description: This file contains implementation support code for pybind11's init factory functions, including templates for constructing and converting C++ classes and aliases, and support for Python object initialization and serialization.

classes.name: type_caster<value_and_holder>
classes.description: Template class for casting 'value_and_holder' types in pybind11.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a handle into a value_and_holder reference.

methods.name: no_nullptr
methods.description: Checks for nullptr and throws type_error if null.

methods.name: construct_or_initialize
methods.description: Constructs a new object, using brace initialization if not directly constructible.

methods.name: construct_alias_from_cpp
methods.description: Constructs an alias type from a Cpp type if possible.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructs and assigns a value or pointer to a pybind11 holder.

methods.name: construct_from_shared_ptr
methods.description: Constructs a pybind11 holder from a shared_ptr.

methods.name: init_smart_holder_from_unique_ptr
methods.description: Creates a smart_holder from a unique_ptr.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Template class for defining __init__ methods with various argument types.

methods.name: alias_constructor
methods.description: Template class for defining __init__ methods for alias types.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Template class for creating factory functions for class initialization.

methods.name: setstate
methods.description: Sets the C++ state of an object, optionally updating Python dict.

methods.name: pickle_factory
methods.description: Template class for defining __getstate__ and __setstate__ for pickling.
